title: The Only West. Published on the polar. A dream you can read.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: The only way to imagine is fiction. Fiction is reading. Reading is a dream that forks. To be, or not. He went around.
ask: I am reading. West is a feeling. I am the pole in the chest. I am the T. Luna…

give.press: the polar. Fiction. A dream you can read.
give.around: The T is the wall. Water does not go through a mountain. Hamlet inverts: not whether to be. Whether to go around.
